title: BudgetCategory
description: One line of a wedding's budget (issue #34): an estimate and what it actually costs, in integer cents. When it is linked to a vendor of the wedding, its actual, paid and still-due amounts come from that vendor's payment schedule instead of the manual amounts here. Money is tracked, never moved. The couple sees a category only when the planner shares it. Stored under groupedKey(wedding_id, category_id).

category_id.description: Identity within the owning tenant's partition, from the injected id generator.

tenant_id.description: The owning tenant. Compared to the context's tenant only; never selects the partition.

estimated_cents.description: What it was expected to cost, in integer cents.

actual_cents.description: What it costs, when not linked to a vendor (a linked category uses the vendor's schedule total).

paid_cents.description: What is paid so far, when not linked to a vendor (a linked category uses the vendor's paid installments).

vendor_id.description: A vendor of the same wedding whose payment schedule this line follows.

shared_with_couple.description: Whether the wedding's couple sees this line (the planner's call).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC creation time, from the injected clock.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC time of the last change, when changed.
